title: Dripps
tagline: A community-driven social event dapp that helps individuals to find nearby activities, and formations.
description:
Dripps is a community-driven social event dapp that helps individuals to find nearby activities and formations.

You can connect via your lens handle, your wallet, and social dapps. Dripps will help organizers and managers to freely establish their community base for ongoing activities or large-scale events. For large events.

Once you connect, you can see either a list view of formations/activities/events happening nearby on the homepage. Or you can search on a map view.

You can choose an event PoaP details, and then you can get the relevant information (direction, QR functionality, attendance list etc.). Formation promises, information about their goals, and social handles.

You can look at your mint history and see how you are active.  You can have analytics of your traction - See and analyze who is interested and who is actually participating.

We have a business model for possible partnerships with marketplaces like Opensea. It would be ideal actually to offer the dapp for free. To do that, I’m considering showcasing local or most promising NFT collections. Event planners can also accept donations. And donations will be visible on the details page.
how_its_made: For purposes of the hackathon, we have created a main smart contract that creates and holds all events. This contract can also call an external contract that would create a POAP token. The event host can call the contract and create a new event with specific data. On-chain data can be matched with external data that can be stored in any form. External data provide additional information like event titles, media, geotags, and socials. Micro front-end app written using reactive framework allows users to submit the create-new-event type of transaction.
